verdict.rationale: Netlify has no documented native bulk-operation feature. Its REST API and CLI let users manage sites, deploys and DNS programmatically for automating workflows, so bulk actions are possible only by scripting loops over many items. Team-level management of secrets and env vars hints at multi-project scope but is not described as a bulk action. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch endpoints or commands, multi-select bulk actions in the dashboard, documentation of applying one change across many sites or deploys at once, and hands-on corroboration.
